After reaching the targets, all four drones move west for 74m, then south for 66m, then north for 84m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 74m, south 66m, north 84m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
